lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) using their raw data API. The dataset represents approximately 40% of total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 2 years and 6% of features updated within the last 6 months.
